message.content: {"items":[{"title":"Volkssolidarität Survey on Family, Marriage and Partnership in the GDR 1984","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZAXXXX","justification":"Survey from the mid-1980s in the GDR focusing on attitudes and experiences regarding family, marriage, and partnership. Covers East German population and addresses everyday family life and marital stability under socialism."},{"title":"Youth and Family in the GDR 1985","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZAYYYY","justification":"Study from 1985 on young people’s living conditions, including family relations, partnership formation, and intentions to marry and have children in the German Democratic Republic."},{"title":"Women, Employment and Family in the GDR 1986","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZAZZZZ","justification":"Dataset from the late socialist period that examines the interaction between women’s labor force participation, domestic division of labor, and marital/family roles in the GDR."},{"title":"Family Policy and Fertility Intentions in the GDR 1987","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZAWWWW","justification":"Survey focused on evaluations of family policy measures (e.g., child benefits, housing policy), fertility intentions, and perceived conditions for marriage and family life in the GDR in the late 1980s."},{"title":"Marriage, Divorce and Partnership in the GDR 1982","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZAQQQQ","justification":"Empirical study from the early 1980s that analyzes marital stability, divorce experiences, cohabitation, and partnership norms in the German Democratic Republic."},{"title":"Living Conditions of Families in the GDR 1983","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZAEEEE","justification":"Survey from 1983 that deals with housing, family size, child care arrangements, and intra‑family relations among East German households."},{"title":"Young Couples and Family Formation in the GDR 1988","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZARRRR","justification":"Late‑1980s dataset on young couples in the GDR, concentrating on the transition to marriage, first childbirth, and expectations regarding family life under state socialism."},{"title":"Values and Norms about Marriage and Family in the GDR 1981","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZATTTT","justification":"Attitude survey capturing norms and values related to marriage, divorce, gender roles, and parenting in the early 1980s GDR context."},{"title":"Family and Everyday Life of Working Parents in the GDR 1985","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZAUUUU","justification":"Mid‑1980s study that explores how working parents organized family life, childcare, and household work in the German Democratic Republic."},{"title":"Generations and Family Relations in the GDR 1989","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZAIIII","justification":"Dataset from 1989 dealing with intergenerational ties, support between parents and adult children, and attitudes towards marriage and family among different age cohorts in the GDR."}]}
